method: Apply Q80's MEASURED per-organ physical BPW (mixed-sub655-v1 PACK_REPORT) to Qwen3.8 DENSE geometry. Qwen3.8 has no experts; its per-layer SwiGLU gate/up/down take the roles Q80 routed gate/up/down take.
critical_difference_from_q80: Q80 routed experts carry about 97.5 percent of its mass, so its complete BPW is nearly its expert BPW. Qwen3.8 MLP is only 63.6 percent, so the non-MLP mass DOMINATES the average. Compressing the MLP alone cannot reach the target; embedding and attention mass decides it.
verdict: G016 2.0 BPW target is REACHABLE with Q80 existing recipe applied verbatim, at about 1.886 BPW, leaving non-MLP mass at 4 bits. It clears the 3.0 hard limit comfortably. No new codec research required; the work is generalising the packer tensor classification from MoE to dense, plus a real Qwen3.8 activation capture.
blocking_work: lab/operators/q80_mixed_representation_pack.py classify() and execution_order() key on model.layers.N.mlp.experts.M.* and must generalise to dense mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj
down_proj HGRAVS01 low-rank needs REAL post-SwiGLU X captured from the Qwen3.8 BF16 source. Synthetic activations are known-invalid here: every prior sub-bit negative was a gaussian-proxy artifact.
Dense means NO never-routed experts, so the weight-space-SVD fallback caveat Q80 carries DISAPPEARS - every row has real activations.
